question: What plant-derived sources are permitted as alternatives in this ritual preparation?
premises: Substances born from trees are included.
Substances born from roots are included.
Substances born from flowers or fruits are also included.
inference: Tree-born, root-born, flower-born, and fruit-born substances are all permitted alternatives.
uncertainties: The exact substances intended are not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: Substances born from trees, from roots, and indeed from flowers or from fruits are also allowed.
